name: Moment Cards
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Wedding run-of-show on the deck: a big card for each moment a minute ahead, with countdown, song and MC line.
description: Put MOMENTS.txt at the top of the USB, one line per moment: 19:15 | First Dance | Perfect - Ed Sheeran | Couple to the floor. A minute ahead (or 2 or 5) a full-screen card shows the moment, a countdown, the song and whether a deck has it loaded, and the MC line; tap it to shrink it to a small countdown, and a short NOW card shows at the moment. Time zone row for the venue (US daylight saving built in); Show test card to check it. Read-only: no controls, audio or library writes.
